model.name: openai/gpt-4.1
model.about: OpenAI: GPT-4.1, through OpenRouter at $2 in and $8 out per million tokens.

answers.sql:
SELECT ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch ON txn.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(a.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

-- Count of clients (customers) in default at the end of August 2025
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d_cust.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f_ln_dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_ln_dlq.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust ON f_ln_dlq.CUST_K = d_cust.CUST_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_DT = (
    SELECT MAX(d_dt2.CAL_DT)
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt2
    WHERE d_dt2.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND d_dt2.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-08-31'
)
AND f_ln_dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT cctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT fc
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cctg ON fc.CMPLT_CTG_K = cctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fc.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY cctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
  ccy.CCY_K,
  ccy.CCY_NM,
  ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS CCY_CODE,
  AVG(rt.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D rt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON rt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON rt.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.CCY_K, ccy.CCY_NM, ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.CCY_NM;

SELECT
  f.MKT_K AS market_key,
  SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.MKT_K
ORDER BY f.MKT_K;

DELETE FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST a
USING (
  SELECT MIN(ctid) as ctid_keep, BUS_ID, LGL_NM, GVN_NM, FMLY_NM, BRTH_DT
  FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
  GROUP BY BUS_ID, LGL_NM, GVN_NM, FMLY_NM, BRTH_DT
) b
WHERE a.BUS_ID = b.BUS_ID
  AND a.LGL_NM = b.LGL_NM
  AND a.GVN_NM = b.GVN_NM
  AND a.FMLY_NM = b.FMLY_NM
  AND a.BRTH_DT = b.BRTH_DT
  AND a.ctid <> b.ctid_keep;

SELECT 
  ACCT_TYP_CD1,
  COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT br.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
  AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND br.IS_ACTV = TRUE
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(fxr.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fxr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fxr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE fxr.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  COUNT(f.CD_FEE_F_K) AS card_dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
  CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
  COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS num_customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS pct_declined
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
  COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY c.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT F_ACCT_TXN.CHNL_K AS channel_id, SUM(F_ACCT_TXN.FEE_AMT) AS total_fee_amt_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_ACCT_TXN.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY F_ACCT_TXN.CHNL_K
ORDER BY F_ACCT_TXN.CHNL_K;

SELECT SUM(TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS dsb
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsb.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dsb.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT 
  prd.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
  SUM(rp.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT rp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON rp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD prd ON rp.LN_PRD_K = prd.LN_PRD_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY prd.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY prd.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT wr.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers_cross_border_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST cust ON wr.CUST_K = cust.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE cust.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND wr.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  atm_txn_counts.atm_txn_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    f.BR_K,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.BR_K
) atm_txn_counts
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm_txn_counts.BR_K = br.BR_K AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN (
  SELECT
    br2.RGN_CD1,
    MAX(atm_txn_count) AS max_txn_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      f2.BR_K,
      COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f2
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON f2.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
    WHERE d2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY f2.BR_K
  ) atm_txn_counts2
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br2 ON atm_txn_counts2.BR_K = br2.BR_K AND br2.IS_CURR = TRUE
  GROUP BY br2.RGN_CD1
) max_counts ON br.RGN_CD1 = max_counts.RGN_CD1 AND atm_txn_counts.atm_txn_count = max_counts.max_txn_count
ORDER BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT f.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code, SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  wr.CCY_K,
  ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(wr.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON wr.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY wr.CCY_K, ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.CUST_K) AS num_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dta ON a.BUS_DT_K = dta.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dtw ON w.BUS_DT_K = dtw.DT_K
WHERE dta.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dtw.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

DELETE FROM bank_dwh.d_cust a
USING (
    SELECT MIN(ctid) as ctid_keep, 
           array_agg(ctid) as ctid_dupes
    FROM bank_dwh.d_cust
    GROUP BY BUS_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) b
WHERE a.ctid = ANY(b.ctid_dupes)
  AND a.ctid <> b.ctid_keep;
DROP TABLE bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

SELECT DSPLY_NM AS branch_name
FROM bank_dwh.D_BR;

SELECT
  wr.CCY_K,
  ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(wr.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON wr.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY wr.CCY_K, ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;

SELECT chnl.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(txn.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL chnl ON txn.CHNL_K = chnl.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY chnl.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(a.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

-- Count of clients (customers) in default at the end of August 2025
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d_cust.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f_ln_dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_ln_dlq.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust ON f_ln_dlq.CUST_K = d_cust.CUST_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_DT = (
    SELECT MAX(d_dt2.CAL_DT)
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt2
    WHERE d_dt2.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND d_dt2.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-08-31'
)
AND f_ln_dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT cctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT fc
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cctg ON fc.CMPLT_CTG_K = cctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fc.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY cctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
  ccy.CCY_K,
  ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  AVG(rt.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D rt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON rt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON rt.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.CCY_K, ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT
  f.MKT_K AS market_key,
  SUM(f.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.MKT_K
ORDER BY f.MKT_K;

DELETE FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST a
USING (
    SELECT MIN(ctid) as ctid_keep, BUS_ID, LGL_NM, GVN_NM, FMLY_NM, BRTH_DT
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    GROUP BY BUS_ID, LGL_NM, GVN_NM, FMLY_NM, BRTH_DT
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) dups
WHERE a.BUS_ID = dups.BUS_ID
  AND a.LGL_NM = dups.LGL_NM
  AND a.GVN_NM = dups.GVN_NM
  AND a.FMLY_NM = dups.FMLY_NM
  AND a.BRTH_DT = dups.BRTH_DT
  AND a.ctid <> dups.ctid_keep;

SELECT 
  ACCT_TYP_CD1,
  COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT br.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
  AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND br.IS_ACTV = TRUE
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(fx.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fx.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE fx.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  COUNT(f.CD_FEE_F_K) AS card_disputes_raised
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS num_customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND c.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pct_declined
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
  COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY c.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT 
  F_ACCT_TXN.CHNL_K AS channel_id,
  SUM(F_ACCT_TXN.FEE_AMT) AS total_fee_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_ACCT_TXN.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY F_ACCT_TXN.CHNL_K
ORDER BY F_ACCT_TXN.CHNL_K;

SELECT SUM(FCD.TXN_AMT) AS total_fraud_dispute_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT FCD
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT DDT ON FCD.BUS_DT_K = DDT.DT_K
WHERE FCD.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND DDT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS dsb
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsb.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dsb.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT 
  prd.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
  SUM(rp.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT rp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON rp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD prd ON rp.LN_PRD_K = prd.LN_PRD_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY prd.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY prd.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fwt.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST dc ON fwt.CUST_K = dc.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON fwt.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
WHERE dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND fwt.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  atm_txn.branch_atm_txn_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    br.BR_K,
    br.RGN_CD1,
    br.DSPLY_NM,
    COUNT(f_atm.ATM_TXN_F_K) AS branch_atm_txn_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY br.RGN_CD1 ORDER BY COUNT(f_atm.ATM_TXN_F_K) DESC) AS rn
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f_atm
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON f_atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f_atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
  WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
    AND br.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  GROUP BY br.BR_K, br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
) atm_txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm_txn.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE atm_txn.rn = 1
ORDER BY atm_txn.region_code;

SELECT f.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code, SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  wr.CCY_K,
  ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(wr.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON wr.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY wr.CCY_K, ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.CUST_K) AS num_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dta ON a.BUS_DT_K = dta.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dtw ON w.BUS_DT_K = dtw.DT_K
WHERE dta.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dtw.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

DELETE FROM bank_dwh.d_cust a
USING (
    SELECT MIN(ctid) as ctid_keep, 
           array_agg(ctid) as ctid_dupes
    FROM bank_dwh.d_cust
    GROUP BY BUS_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) b
WHERE a.bus_id IS NOT NULL
  AND a.bus_id = (
      SELECT bus_id FROM bank_dwh.d_cust c WHERE c.ctid = b.ctid_keep
  )
  AND a.ctid <> b.ctid_keep
  AND a.ctid = ANY(b.ctid_dupes);
DROP TABLE bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

INSERT INTO bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D (
  BUS_DT_K, CCY_CD1, BS_CCY_CD1, QUOT_CCY_CD1, CCY_PAIR_CD1, MID_RT
)
SELECT 
  dt.DT_K, 
  'USD' AS CCY_CD1, 
  'USD' AS BS_CCY_CD1, 
  'EUR' AS QUOT_CCY_CD1, 
  'USD/EUR' AS CCY_PAIR_CD1, 
  1.10 AS MID_RT
FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31';

SELECT
  ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(fwr.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fwr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON fwr.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT chnl.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name, COUNT(txn.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN txn
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL chnl ON txn.CHNL_K = chnl.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON txn.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY chnl.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(a.AML_ALRT_F_K) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.BR_K, br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

-- Count of clients (customers) in default at the end of August 2025
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d_cust.CUST_K) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D f_ln_dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt ON f_ln_dlq.BUS_DT_K = d_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST d_cust ON f_ln_dlq.CUST_K = d_cust.CUST_K
WHERE d_dt.CAL_DT = (
    SELECT MAX(d_dt2.CAL_DT)
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT d_dt2
    WHERE d_dt2.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-08-01' AND d_dt2.CAL_DT <= DATE '2025-08-31'
)
AND f_ln_dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT cctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category, COUNT(fc.CMPLT_F_K) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT fc
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG cctg ON fc.CMPLT_CTG_K = cctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fc.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY cctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
  ccy.CCY_K,
  ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  AVG(rt.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D rt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON rt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON rt.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.CCY_K, ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT
  F.MKT_K AS market_key,
  SUM(F.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_portfolio_valuation
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D F
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT D ON F.BUS_DT_K = D.DT_K
WHERE D.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY F.MKT_K
ORDER BY F.MKT_K;

DELETE FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST a
USING (
    SELECT MIN(CUST_K) as keep_cust_k, BUS_ID, LGL_NM, GVN_NM, FMLY_NM, BRTH_DT
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    GROUP BY BUS_ID, LGL_NM, GVN_NM, FMLY_NM, BRTH_DT
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) dups
WHERE a.BUS_ID = dups.BUS_ID
  AND a.LGL_NM = dups.LGL_NM
  AND a.GVN_NM = dups.GVN_NM
  AND a.FMLY_NM = dups.FMLY_NM
  AND a.BRTH_DT = dups.BRTH_DT
  AND a.CUST_K <> dups.keep_cust_k;

SELECT 
  ACCT_TYP_CD1,
  COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT br.CTY_NM AS branch_city, COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN atm
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm.BR_K = br.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON atm.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
  AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND br.IS_ACTV = TRUE
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(fx.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D fx
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fx.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE fx.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT
  d.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
  COUNT(f.CD_FEE_F_K) AS card_disputes_raised
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND f.DSPT_RSN_CD1 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY d.MTH_NBR;

SELECT CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY customer_segment;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS num_customers_no_txn_2025
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
);

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN f.PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS pct_declined
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name, COUNT(f.CMPLT_F_K) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG c ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = c.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY c.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT 
  F_ACCT_TXN.CHNL_K AS channel_id,
  SUM(F_ACCT_TXN.FEE_AMT) AS total_fee_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_ACCT_TXN.BUS_DT_K = D_DT.DT_K
WHERE D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY F_ACCT_TXN.CHNL_K
ORDER BY F_ACCT_TXN.CHNL_K;

SELECT SUM(FCD.TXN_AMT) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT FCD
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT DT ON FCD.BUS_DT_K = DT.DT_K
WHERE FCD.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name, COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS dsb
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dsb.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND dsb.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT 
  prd.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
  SUM(rp.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT rp
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON rp.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD prd ON rp.LN_PRD_K = prd.LN_PRD_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY prd.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY prd.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fwt.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST dc ON fwt.CUST_K = dc.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON fwt.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
WHERE dc.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND fwt.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
  br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
  br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
  atm_txn_counts.atm_txn_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    f.BR_K,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
  WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  GROUP BY f.BR_K
) atm_txn_counts
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br ON atm_txn_counts.BR_K = br.BR_K AND br.IS_CURR = TRUE
JOIN (
  SELECT
    br2.RGN_CD1,
    MAX(atm_txn_count) AS max_txn_count
  FROM (
    SELECT
      f2.BR_K,
      COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN f2
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d2 ON f2.BUS_DT_K = d2.DT_K
    WHERE d2.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY f2.BR_K
  ) atm_txn_counts2
  JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br2 ON atm_txn_counts2.BR_K = br2.BR_K AND br2.IS_CURR = TRUE
  GROUP BY br2.RGN_CD1
) max_per_region
  ON br.RGN_CD1 = max_per_region.RGN_CD1
  AND atm_txn_counts.atm_txn_count = max_per_region.max_txn_count
ORDER BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT f.MRCH_CTG_CD1 AS merchant_category_code, SUM(f.TXN_AMT) AS total_authorization_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_FEE f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY f.MRCH_CTG_CD1
ORDER BY total_authorization_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id, SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON f.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.BUS_ID
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  wr.CCY_K,
  ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(wr.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON wr.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY wr.CCY_K, ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.CUST_K) AS num_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dta ON a.BUS_DT_K = dta.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dtw ON w.BUS_DT_K = dtw.DT_K
WHERE dta.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dtw.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT d.CAL_YR_NBR AS year, COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

DELETE FROM bank_dwh.d_cust a
USING (
  SELECT MIN(ctid) as ctid_keep, array_agg(ctid) as ctid_dups
  FROM bank_dwh.d_cust
  GROUP BY BUS_ID
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) b
WHERE a.bus_id IS NOT NULL
  AND a.bus_id = (
    SELECT bus_id FROM bank_dwh.d_cust WHERE ctid = b.ctid_keep
  )
  AND a.ctid <> b.ctid_keep
  AND a.ctid = ANY(b.ctid_dups);
DROP TABLE bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

INSERT INTO bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D (
    BUS_DT_K, CCY_CD1, BS_CCY_CD1, QUOT_CCY_CD1, CCY_PAIR_CD1, MID_RT
)
SELECT 
    dt.DT_K, 
    'USD' AS CCY_CD1, 
    'USD' AS BS_CCY_CD1, 
    'USD' AS QUOT_CCY_CD1, 
    'USD/USD' AS CCY_PAIR_CD1, 
    1.10 AS MID_RT
FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dt
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31';

SELECT
  ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
  SUM(fwr.STLM_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwr
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON fwr.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy ON fwr.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.ISO_ALPH_CD1;
